description: On requests that look like a feature build, restate the boundary: deliver what was asked, do not add unrequested features, abstractions or refactors. Self-cancelling for small edits.

text: If this is a build request: deliver exactly what was asked. Do not add features, abstractions, refactors or configuration the request did not name.
Anchor every change to a file path. If the request is small, ignore this guidance.
